content.content: 1. Necessity: creation needs the creation verb for opening a change after the named dependencies with a required repeatable --on — without it, a new node is motiveless. Fail if the edge can be dropped without loss. 2. License: no element of the elaboration contradicts the parent. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element.
content.rationale: Birth is where the elaboration meets the creation verb; the gate keeps the use sound without testing creation itself.
